terms.gloss: set up again, put back; restore, rebuild; give back
evidence: Cic. Fam. 12.25a.1: senātus dēcrēvit, ut Minerva nostra, quam turbō dējēcerat, restituerētur (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: From statuō: to put a thing back in its place or bring it back to what it was, a statue, a building, a line of battle (Lewis & Short).

phrases.latin: senātus dēcrēvit, ut Minerva nostra, quam turbō dējēcerat, restituerētur
phrases.english: the senate decreed that our Minerva, which a whirlwind had thrown down, should be set up again

re-short.html: The prefix is re-; Lewis & Short writes rē- before sc, sp and st, and only there, for a lengthening that Bennett (The Latin Language §48) rejects.
